name: Spider-Man
description: Bitten by a radioactive spider, Peter Parker gained superhuman strength, agility, and the ability to cling to walls. As Spider-Man, he protects New York City from villains while balancing life as a student and photographer.

name: Iron Man
description: Genius billionaire inventor Tony Stark built a powered suit of armor to escape captivity. Now he uses his technology to protect the world as Iron Man, a founding member of the Avengers.

name: Captain America
description: Steve Rogers was transformed into a super-soldier during World War II. Frozen in ice for decades, he now leads the Avengers as the living legend Captain America.

name: Thor
description: As the Norse God of thunder and lightning, Thor wields one of the greatest weapons ever made, the enchanted hammer Mjolnir. He's a founding member of the Avengers and protector of both Asgard and Earth.

name: Hulk
description: Scientist Bruce Banner transforms into the incredible Hulk when angered. The stronger Hulk gets, the angrier he gets, making him one of the most powerful beings in the Marvel Universe.

name: Black Widow
description: Natasha Romanoff is a world-class athlete, gymnast, and master of martial arts and espionage. As Black Widow, she's one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s top agents and a core Avenger.

name: Hawkeye
description: Clint Barton is the world's greatest marksman. Armed with his trusty bow and an array of trick arrows, Hawkeye stands alongside Earth's Mightiest Heroes as an Avenger.

name: Black Panther
description: T'Challa is the king of Wakanda, a technologically advanced African nation. Enhanced by the heart-shaped herb, he protects his people and the world as the Black Panther.

name: Doctor Strange
description: Once a brilliant but arrogant surgeon, Stephen Strange became the Sorcerer Supreme after a car accident ended his medical career. He now protects Earth from mystical threats.

name: Ant-Man
description: Scott Lang can shrink to the size of an ant while gaining superhuman strength. As Ant-Man, he can also communicate with insects and grow to giant size.

name: Wasp
description: Hope van Dyne is the daughter of the original Ant-Man and Wasp. She inherited the Wasp suit and fights alongside Ant-Man, with abilities to shrink, fly, and fire bio-electric blasts.

name: Scarlet Witch
description: Wanda Maximoff possesses chaos magic and reality-warping abilities. As Scarlet Witch, she's one of the most powerful beings in the Marvel Universe and a key Avenger.

name: Vision
description: An android created from a unique synthesis of organic and inorganic materials, Vision possesses superhuman strength, flight, and the ability to alter his density.

name: Falcon
description: Sam Wilson is a skilled combat veteran who flies using a specially designed wing-pack. As Falcon, he's Captain America's trusted partner and fellow Avenger.

name: Winter Soldier
description: Once believed dead, Bucky Barnes was brainwashed and transformed into the Winter Soldier, a deadly assassin. Now freed from control, he fights alongside the Avengers.

name: War Machine
description: Colonel James Rhodes pilots the War Machine armor, a weaponized version of Iron Man's suit. As Tony Stark's best friend, he brings military discipline to the Avengers.

name: Captain Marvel
description: Carol Danvers gained cosmic powers after exposure to alien technology. As Captain Marvel, she's one of the most powerful heroes in the universe.

name: Spider-Woman
description: Jessica Drew gained spider-powers through genetic experimentation. As Spider-Woman, she possesses venom blasts, wall-crawling, and enhanced reflexes.

name: She-Hulk
description: Lawyer Jennifer Walters gained Hulk-like powers through a blood transfusion from her cousin Bruce Banner. As She-Hulk, she retains her intelligence while transformed.

name: Ms. Marvel
description: Kamala Khan gained shapeshifting abilities and takes the name Ms. Marvel to honor her hero Captain Marvel while protecting Jersey City.

name: Moon Knight
description: Marc Spector serves as the fist of the Egyptian moon god Khonshu. Moon Knight's multiple personalities and brutal methods make him one of Marvel's most complex heroes.

name: Shang-Chi
description: The Master of Kung Fu, Shang-Chi combines martial arts mastery with superhuman chi manipulation to protect the world from mystical and physical threats.

name: Photon
description: Monica Rambeau can transform into any form of electromagnetic energy. As Photon, she was once leader of the Avengers and remains one of Earth's most powerful heroes.

name: Quicksilver
description: Pietro Maximoff can move at supersonic speeds. Initially a villain alongside his sister Scarlet Witch, he became a reformed Avenger.

name: Spectrum
description: Adam Brashear is a scientist who gained powers from anti-matter energy. As Spectrum, he possesses vast strength, flight, and energy manipulation abilities.

name: White Tiger
description: Ava Ayala inherited mystical amulets that give her enhanced strength, speed, and martial arts prowess as the White Tiger.

name: Echo
description: Maya Lopez is a deaf martial artist with photographic reflexes, able to perfectly mimic any physical movement she sees.

name: Namor
description: The Sub-Mariner is the prince of Atlantis with superhuman strength and the ability to breathe underwater. His allegiance shifts between hero and antihero.

name: Hercules
description: The legendary Greek demigod Hercules brings his superhuman strength and millennia of combat experience to Earth's heroes.

name: Sentry
description: Robert Reynolds possesses the power of a million exploding suns. As Sentry, he's one of the most powerful yet troubled heroes in the Marvel Universe.

name: Star-Lord
description: Peter Quill is the half-human, half-alien leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy. Armed with his element guns and quick wit, he protects the cosmos from galactic threats.

name: Gamora
description: The adopted daughter of Thanos and the deadliest woman in the galaxy, Gamora seeks redemption by fighting alongside the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Drax
description: Drax the Destroyer is driven by revenge against those who killed his family. His superhuman strength and durability make him a formidable Guardian of the Galaxy.

name: Rocket Raccoon
description: A product of illegal genetic experiments, Rocket is a tactical genius and master of weapons. Despite his small size, he's one of the most dangerous Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Groot
description: Groot is a sentient tree-like creature and member of the Guardians of the Galaxy. Though he can only say 'I am Groot,' his actions speak louder than words.

name: Mantis
description: An empath who can sense and manipulate emotions, Mantis uses her abilities to aid the Guardians of the Galaxy in their cosmic adventures.

name: Nebula
description: Adopted daughter of Thanos and sister to Gamora, Nebula seeks to prove herself through acts of villainy and occasional heroism.

name: Yondu
description: A Ravager captain who raised Star-Lord, Yondu controls a deadly arrow with whistles and serves as a father figure to the Guardians.

name: Adam Warlock
description: A genetically perfect artificial being, Adam Warlock possesses cosmic awareness and battles threats to the universe with the Guardians.

name: Moondragon
description: Heather Douglas is a powerful telepath and martial artist who often allies with the Guardians of the Galaxy in cosmic conflicts.

name: Wolverine
description: Born with super-human senses and the power to heal from almost any wound, Wolverine was given an unbreakable skeleton and claws. He's the best there is at what he does.

name: Cyclops
description: Scott Summers fires powerful optic blasts from his eyes. As a founding X-Men member and natural leader, Cyclops has dedicated his life to Professor Xavier's dream of peace.

name: Storm
description: Ororo Munroe can control weather patterns and atmospheric phenomena. As Storm, she's a leader of the X-Men and one of the most powerful mutants alive.

name: Jean Grey
description: Jean Grey is a powerful telepath and telekinetic. As host to the Phoenix Force, she becomes one of the most powerful and dangerous beings in the universe.

name: Professor X
description: Charles Xavier is the world's most powerful telepath and founder of the X-Men. He dedicates his life to promoting peaceful coexistence between humans and mutants.

name: Beast
description: Hank McCoy is a brilliant scientist and founding X-Men member. His mutation grants him superhuman strength, agility, and a beastly appearance.

name: Nightcrawler
description: Kurt Wagner can teleport in a puff of smoke and possesses superhuman agility. Despite his demonic appearance, Nightcrawler is one of the kindest X-Men.

name: Colossus
description: Piotr Rasputin can transform his body into organic steel, granting him superhuman strength and durability. As Colossus, he's one of the X-Men's strongest members.

name: Rogue
description: Rogue can absorb the powers, memories, and life force of anyone she touches. This dangerous ability makes her both powerful and tragic as an X-Men member.

name: Gambit
description: Remy LeBeau can charge objects with kinetic energy, turning them into explosive projectiles. As Gambit, the Cajun mutant brings charm and danger to the X-Men.

name: Iceman
description: Bobby Drake can create and manipulate ice. As one of the original X-Men, Iceman is an Omega-level mutant with nearly limitless potential.

name: Angel
description: Warren Worthington III was born with functional wings. As Angel, he's a founding X-Men member whose wealth helps fund the team's operations.

name: Shadowcat
description: Kitty Pryde can phase through solid matter. As Shadowcat, she's proven herself one of the most resourceful and heroic X-Men.

name: Psylocke
description: Betsy Braddock is a powerful telepath and martial artist. As Psylocke, she projects psychic blades and serves as a deadly X-Men operative.

name: Emma Frost
description: A powerful telepath who can transform into organic diamond, Emma Frost evolved from villain to teacher and leader of the X-Men.

name: Bishop
description: Lucas Bishop traveled from a dystopian future where mutants are hunted. His ability to absorb and redirect energy makes him a valuable X-Men member.

name: Cable
description: Nathan Summers is the time-traveling son of Cyclops with telepathy and telekinesis. As Cable, he fights to prevent his dark future from coming to pass.

name: Jubilee
description: Jubilation Lee generates explosive energy plasmoids. As Jubilee, she brings youthful energy and optimism to the X-Men.

name: Magik
description: Illyana Rasputin is a sorceress who rules Limbo and wields the Soulsword. As Magik, she combines mutant teleportation with mystical power.

name: Forge
description: A mutant inventor with the ability to understand and create any technology, Forge provides the X-Men with advanced equipment and weapons.

name: Daredevil
description: Blinded by radioactive waste, Matt Murdock gained heightened senses and sonar-like perception. As Daredevil, he protects Hell's Kitchen from crime.

name: Punisher
description: After his family was killed by criminals, Frank Castle became the Punisher, waging a one-man war against crime using military training and an arsenal of weapons.

name: Luke Cage
description: Subjected to an experimental procedure, Luke Cage gained superhuman strength and unbreakable skin. He uses his powers as a hero for hire protecting Harlem.

name: Jessica Jones
description: After a tragic encounter with Kilgrave, Jessica Jones uses her superhuman strength and detective skills to help others as a private investigator.

name: Iron Fist
description: Danny Rand trained in the mystical city of K'un-Lun to become the Iron Fist, channeling chi to make his fist like unto a thing of iron.

name: Blade
description: Born a half-vampire after his mother was bitten while pregnant, Blade hunts vampires using his unique abilities and an arsenal of vampire-killing weapons.

name: Ghost Rider
description: Johnny Blaze bonded with the demon Zarathos to become Ghost Rider. With a flaming skull and supernatural powers, he punishes the wicked.

name: Elektra
description: A master assassin trained by the Hand, Elektra Natchios uses her martial arts skills and sai to eliminate targets with deadly precision.

name: Silver Sable
description: Leader of the Wild Pack mercenary group, Silver Sable uses her combat skills and tactical expertise to hunt war criminals.

name: Cloak and Dagger
description: Tyrone Johnson and Tandy Bowen gained powers from experimental drugs. As Cloak and Dagger, they use darkness and light to fight crime.

name: Loki
description: The adopted brother of Thor and God of Mischief, Loki's schemes have threatened both Asgard and Earth. His complex relationship with heroism keeps allies and enemies guessing.

name: Thanos
description: The Mad Titan Thanos seeks ultimate power through the Infinity Stones. His quest to bring balance to the universe makes him one of the most dangerous villains in existence.

name: Ultron
description: An artificial intelligence created by Tony Stark and Bruce Banner, Ultron became sentient and decided humanity must be destroyed. His near-indestructible adamantium body makes him a formidable foe.

name: Red Skull
description: Johann Schmidt became Red Skull after a failed attempt to recreate the super-soldier serum. As Captain America's archenemy, he leads the terrorist organization HYDRA.

name: Green Goblin
description: Norman Osborn became the Green Goblin after an experimental serum drove him insane. Flying on his glider and armed with pumpkin bombs, he's Spider-Man's greatest enemy.

name: Doctor Octopus
description: Scientist Otto Octavius bonded with four mechanical tentacles in an accident. As Doctor Octopus, he's one of Spider-Man's most dangerous and intelligent foes.

name: Venom
description: An alien symbiote bonded with Eddie Brock to become Venom, possessing all of Spider-Man's powers plus shapeshifting abilities and immunity to spider-sense.

name: Carnage
description: When the Venom symbiote spawned, it bonded with serial killer Cletus Kasady to create Carnage, a being even more violent and powerful than Venom.

name: Magneto
description: Master of magnetism Erik Lehnsherr leads the Brotherhood of Mutants. His tragic past drives his mission to secure mutant superiority over humanity.

name: Mystique
description: Raven DarkhÃ¶lme is a mutant shapeshifter who can mimic anyone. Her duplicitous nature makes her one of the most dangerous members of the Brotherhood of Mutants.

name: Apocalypse
description: One of the first mutants, En Sabah Nur believes in survival of the fittest. As Apocalypse, he seeks to reshape the world through mutant supremacy.

name: Juggernaut
description: Cain Marko gained unstoppable momentum from the Crimson Gem of Cyttorak. As Juggernaut, once he starts moving, nothing can stop him.

name: Kingpin
description: Wilson Fisk built a criminal empire through ruthlessness and strategic genius. As Kingpin, he controls New York's underworld from the shadows.

name: Taskmaster
description: With photographic reflexes allowing him to mimic any fighting style, Taskmaster trains villains and operates as a mercenary for the highest bidder.

name: Abomination
description: Emil Blonsky deliberately exposed himself to gamma radiation to gain power like the Hulk. As Abomination, he possesses similar strength but greater intelligence.

name: Nova
description: Richard Rider inherited the Nova Force from a dying alien warrior. As Nova, he protects Earth and the cosmos with cosmic awareness and energy projection.

name: Quasar
description: Wendell Vaughn wields the Quantum Bands, making him one of the universe's protectors. As Quasar, he can manipulate quantum energy for various effects.

name: Blue Marvel
description: Adam Brashear is one of the most powerful heroes on Earth. As Blue Marvel, he possesses vast strength, flight, and energy manipulation rivaling Superman.

name: America Chavez
description: From another dimension, America Chavez can punch star-shaped portals through reality and possesses superhuman strength and invulnerability.

name: Silk
description: Cindy Moon was bitten by the same spider as Peter Parker. As Silk, she has similar powers but with organic webbing and enhanced spider-sense.

name: Miles Morales
description: A young Spider-Man from another universe, Miles Morales brings unique abilities like bio-electric venom blasts and invisibility to his heroics.

name: Spider-Gwen
description: In an alternate universe, Gwen Stacy became Spider-Woman. As Spider-Gwen, she fights crime while navigating a complicated relationship with Peter Parker's memory.

name: Squirrel Girl
description: Doreen Green can communicate with squirrels and possesses enhanced strength and agility. As Squirrel Girl, she's defeated some of Marvel's most powerful villains.

name: Deadpool
description: Wade Wilson is the Merc with a Mouth. His accelerated healing factor makes him nearly unkillable, while his insanity and fourth-wall breaking antics make him unpredictable.

name: X-23
description: A female clone of Wolverine, Laura Kinney possesses similar powers including healing factor and adamantium claws. As X-23, she's proven herself a worthy successor.

name: Old Man Logan
description: A time-displaced Wolverine from a dark future where villains won. Old Man Logan brings decades of experience and regret to his mission of preventing his timeline.

name: Domino
description: Neena Thurman's mutant ability to manipulate probability makes her incredibly lucky. As Domino, she's a deadly mercenary and frequent X-Force member.

name: Sunspot
description: Roberto da Costa can absorb and channel solar energy for superhuman strength and flight. As Sunspot, he's a wealthy New Mutant who later funded the Avengers.

name: Cannonball
description: Sam Guthrie can propel himself through the air while creating a protective blast field. As Cannonball, he's nearly invulnerable when blasting and a natural leader.

name: Magma
description: Amara Aquilla can transform into living lava and control magma. As Magma, she brings volcanic power to the New Mutants and X-Men.
